// diagnostic

E0749

A function reaches an effect outside a ceiling it answers to (a package `authority` `allow` row or a module `#FX(…)` cap), or one a `-[!E]>` row, module cap or package `deny` prohibits, including a denied `Panic` stop

What

A function reaches an effect outside a ceiling it answers to (a package `authority` `allow` row or a module `#FX(…)` cap), or one a `-[!E]>` row, module cap or package `deny` prohibits, including a denied `Panic` stop

Why

An effect ceiling or prohibition holds for everything its scope calls; the report names the effect or panic site, the call chain that reaches it and the scope that set the limit

Fix

Remove the offending effect, return a fallible result, add facts or a `#Pre`/refinement proof, widen the ceiling, or drop the prohibition

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0749: Tests/UI/Effects/library_effect_case_denial_whole_is_e0749.stderr.

Error [jet.ProhibitedEffectReached]: `keep` reaches the library effect `Disk`, which it prohibits with `-[!Disk.Write]>`
  --> Tests/UI/Effects/library_effect_case_denial_whole_is_e0749.jet:13:27
    |
 13 | keep: fn(path: String) -[!Disk.Write]> String { load(path) }
    |                           ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `-[!Disk.Write]>` row means the function and every callee it can reach must not use `Disk.Write`; a function uses a library effect when its row names the effect or one of its cases
 Fix: Remove the call that introduces `Disk`, or drop the `-[!Disk.Write]>` prohibition
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: keep
